newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Jan 3.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - S.Korean newspapers - Jan 3.

text.p: The following is a summary of major South Korean political stories in leading newspapers, prepared by Reuters in Seoul. Reuters has not checked the stories and does not gaurantee their accuracy. Telephone: (822) 727-5650. Fax: (822) 727-5666.
- Japan shows signs of sending relief rice aid to North Korea after official apology by the North Korean government over submarine infiltration incident.
- From January 1, a system of examinging arrest warrants before authorisation has been enacted acccording to new ammendments in the law.
- From February 1, certain foreign businesses will be able to rent land free of charge or at discount rates for up to 20 years.
- A biting cold wave, heavy snow and strong winds hit the nation hard on New Year's day, crippling traffic on highways as people returned to big cities at the end of the two-day holiday.
